standard-dialogue-near-the-dwarven-mine-.player: Hello there. What are you doing all the way out here?

standard-dialogue-near-the-dwarven-mine-.npc: Nothing you need to worry about.

standard-dialogue-at-nardah.player: So this is where you scampered off to after the monster awoke?

standard-dialogue-at-nardah.npc: Look [player name], it was a simple misunderstanding, that's all...

standard-dialogue-at-nardah.player: Oh really? You threatening to kill me was just a misunderstanding?

standard-dialogue-at-nardah.npc: Things got a little heated down there, but we all made it out alive, right?

standard-dialogue-at-nardah.player: Barely... I had to defeat that monster on my own!
What are you doing out here, anyway?

standard-dialogue-at-nardah.npc: We thought you'd rat us out to the authorities, so we came out here to hide.
Plus, we heard there are some sealed tombs in the desert that haven't been touched in hundreds of years...

standard-dialogue-at-nardah.player: Ah, of course... scoping out your next grave to rob.
